title: Neural topic modelling of fibroblast measurements and diabetic foot ulcer healing: analysis software and reproduction archive
description: A patient-level audit of frozen neural topic measurements in diabetic foot ulcer research. The release includes the producing analysis programs, public processed inputs, numerical evidence, fixed model states, mappings, and corrected journal documents. Healing inference uses eleven discovery patients. The analysis evaluates measurement decomposition, technical sensitivity, topic selection, refits and tissue context; it does not establish prospective healing prediction or independent clinical validation. This full reproduction archive contains the corrected inline journal manuscript, submission-layout manuscript, supplement, editable journal sources, analysis code, public processed inputs and saved research outputs. The DOI was reserved at local archive assembly; publication is a separate operation. MIT applies to authored software only. Manuscripts, figures, saved research outputs, source-study materials and third-party fonts retain the rights stated in NOTICE; the archive does not relicense those materials.
notes: Mixed-rights archive: the primary software license applies to authored software; see NOTICE and journal/source/measurement/fonts/ for source-data, scholarly-output and font terms.
